conventions.bins: filter bin k is Omega T0 = k 2pi/40 on the solver's centered frequency axis (window 40 T0); Omega = omega - omega0 is the physical detuning (solver convention A(t) = sum_k A_k exp(-i Omega_k t), positive Omega = higher optical frequency). 'mirror' uses bins -k.
conventions.F: Var(N_T)/<N_T>, linearized vacuum noise of the coherent input; Var = sum |dN_T/dconj(B(0))|^2 from solve_adjoint(...; adjoint_mode=:discrete_rk4ip)
conventions.case_A_s_to_0: F_s0 = mean of the filter and mirrored-filter values at omega0 T0 = 1e9 (parity maps (T, s) to (-T, -s), so the mean is F(s=0) + O(s^2))

headline.note: F to 6 significant digits; 'filter' = bins k as given (Omega = +k 2pi/40 T0, physical detuning), 'mirror' = bins -k. Full-precision values and checks below.
